reference.pathophysiology: Extramedullary compression produces a sensory level with spastic paraparesis and early incontinence demanding hours-fast decompression; B12 starves dorsal columns, syrinx splits pain and temperature in a cape, and motor neuron disease spares sensation entirely.
additionalDifferentials: Compressive versus B12 versus syrinx versus MND by level dorsal cape and sensation
Cord versus cauda by reflexes and saddle
Complete versus incomplete by sacral sparing
